reason: I'll take the free listing, but I won't put a new startup's QR code on every table and route my guests' payments and contact details through it. Three free months doesn't help if they disappear in a year with my regulars' data, and in the off-season I can't tell whether it pays for itself.
objection: Who owns my guest list and reviews, and what happens to them if this startup closes or gets sold? On top of that, a payment fee on every bill, plus my staff and older regulars getting confused by QR payment.
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee that the guest data is mine and I can export it any time, plus two or three restaurants I know in Tbilisi telling me it brought guests back and the fees were fair.
